description: This file contains implementation of internal functions for the ohcm (OpenHome Camera) library, including curl setup, mutual TLS configuration, XML parsing, and response handling, specific to camera device management.

methods.name: initOhcm
methods.description: Initializes the curl and libxml2 libraries; safe to call multiple times.

methods.name: cleanupOhcm
methods.description: Cleans up resources; curl cleanup is commented out.

methods.name: setOhcmMutualTlsMode
methods.description: Sets filenames for mutual TLS certificates and private keys.

methods.name: ohcmIsMtlsCapable
methods.description: Checks if mutual TLS files are accessible and capable.

methods.name: ohcmSetTLSVerify
methods.description: Sets the TLS verification level.

methods.name: ohcmGetTLSVerify
methods.description: Retrieves the current TLS verification level.

methods.name: applyOhcmMutualTls
methods.description: Configures curl for mutual TLS if filenames are set and files exist.

methods.name: ohcmTranslateCurlCode
methods.description: Maps curl error codes to ohcm result codes.

methods.name: ohcmTranslateHttpCode
methods.description: Maps HTTP response codes to curl codes.

methods.name: createOhcmCurlContext
methods.description: Creates and configures a curl handle with standard options and mutual TLS.

methods.name: destroyOhcmCurlContext
methods.description: Cleans up a curl handle.

methods.name: ohcmPerformCurlGet
methods.description: Performs a curl GET request with retries, stores response in buffer.

methods.name: ohcmPerformCurlPost
methods.description: Performs a curl POST request with retries, stores response in buffer.

methods.name: ohcmExportXmlToBuffer
methods.description: Serializes an XML document and appends it to a buffer.

methods.name: curlWriteMemoryCallback
methods.description: Callback to write curl response data into buffer.

methods.name: curlReadMemoryCallback
methods.description: Callback to read payload data for curl POST from buffer.

methods.name: parseBasicXmlNode
methods.description: Parses basic response XML nodes for status code and message.

methods.name: ohcmParseBasicResponse
methods.description: Parses basic response XML from buffer.

methods.name: ohcmTranslateOhcmResponseCode
methods.description: Converts ohcm response codes to internal result codes.

methods.name: ohcmTranslateOhcmResponseCodeToCurl
methods.description: Converts ohcm response codes to curl error codes.

methods.name: ohcmParseXmlHelper
methods.description: Parses XML buffer into document and iterates over nodes, calling callback.

methods.name: ohcmParseXmlNodeChildren
methods.description: Iterates over child nodes of a given XML node, calling callback.
